name: Willowbrook
questions: The aerials show a bungalow about 30–40 m to the west and sheds, caravans and vans just beyond the east hedge. Who uses the east plot (a house, a yard or a farm), and is there any business or livestock there?
Overhead lines cross the back garden on wooden poles. Are they ESB or telecoms, is there a wayleave, and could they be moved or put underground?
Is the full 0.99 acres, including the rear meadow, fenced dog-proof all round? Can you send the folio map?
How deep and how old are the private well and the septic tank or treatment system? Is there a recent water test, and is the septic system registered and recently inspected?

What broadband is connected now (NBI fibre, or other), and what do the solar panels feed (PV or hot water)? BuyerIQ flags one critical and one high-priority finding behind its paywall; are you aware of any planning, radon or title issue?

ai.why: A turnkey 221 m² BER B dormer at €445k with a proper parents' suite downstairs (en-suite master plus two more ground-floor bedrooms) and three full bathrooms on about an acre. Held back by a plain 2000s interior, neighbours about 30–40 m away on both sides with only partial hedging, overhead lines over the garden, and 20 minutes to Wexford's ED. Held at 2.5 on the rubric's rule that plain with close neighbours stays 2.5 (bungalow ~30–40 m west, sheds and vans ~40–60 m east), as with Monmore.

electricity.detail: Mains; 'Electricity' is in the listing's services line, plus solar panels; overhead lines cross the back garden.

water.detail: Private well; the listing says 'private water'. Ask its depth, yield and a recent water test.

sewer.detail: Septic tank; the listing says 'private sewerage' (type not stated). Ask age, registration and last inspection.

internet.detail: Unknown; not stated in the listing and BuyerIQ's broadband is paywalled. The area was in NBI survey works in 2021 and NBI's rollout is due to finish by end-2026; check the Eircode on nbi.ie/map.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: The master bedroom (3.5 × 3.8 m) is on the ground floor with a 2.7 × 1.2 m shower en-suite, beside Bedroom 2 (3.8 × 3.3 m), Bedroom 3 (3.3 × 3.0 m) and the family bathroom, per the floor plan.

bedsNote: Three ground-floor bedrooms (master en-suite) plus two attic rooms upstairs (5 × 4 m and 5.7 × 5 m) listed as attic room and study
heating: Oil-fired central heating, a feature stove in the living room, and solar panels
tagline: A turnkey stone-fronted dormer of 221 m² with three bedrooms downstairs, on about an acre at Knocktown, 1 km from Rathangan village in south Wexford.

pros.text: Parents' suite on the ground floor
pros.detail: The 3.5 × 3.8 m master has a shower en-suite, and two more double bedrooms (3.8 × 3.3 m and 3.3 × 3.0 m) and the family bathroom are on the same hall.
En-suite, ground-floor family bathroom with a bath and shower, and a 3.8 × 2.5 m first-floor bathroom with a bath and double shower, plus a WC off the utility.
About €2,014/m² and €55k under the €500k budget; stamp duty about €4,450.

pros.text: About an acre with a rear meadow
pros.detail: 0.99 ac: front lawns behind gated pillars, a fenced back lawn with a play area, a rewilded field behind, and a 6.9 × 4.7 m (32 m²) detached garage.
Rathangan NS (co-ed, 236 pupils) was rated 'good' across learning, teaching and leadership in its May 2025 Whole-School Evaluation.
129.87 kWh/m²/yr (B3 by the kWh figure; the listing says only 'B'), solar panels, oil heating and a stove; shown in move-in condition.
4.8 × 4.5 m kitchen with an island opening to a 3.9 × 3.5 m dining area with French doors, plus a 4.7 × 4.6 m living room with a stove.

cons.detail: The listing's aerials show a bungalow about 30–40 m west across a hedge and a cluster of sheds, caravans and vans 40–60 m east behind trees, with a farm shed about 100 m north-west; the rear boundary is open post-and-rail.
Stone façade at the front but a plain rendered back, laminate floors downstairs, carpet in the attic rooms and a high-gloss black kitchen; little particular character.

cons.text: 20 minutes to the ED and town
cons.detail: Wexford General is about 14 km in a straight line (roughly 18–20 min); the village has no shop, so the nearest found is Centra in Bridgetown (about 5 km).
Wexford O'Hanrahan, about 15 km, has about 4 direct trains a weekday to Connolly taking about 2 h 40 min.
Wooden poles carry lines across the back lawn beside the play area (ESB or telecoms not stated).
'Private water, private sewerage' per the listing; broadband not stated, and BuyerIQ flags one critical and one high-priority finding behind its paywall.
